prompts.display_text: Pin a country where Saints vol. 3 or Global Histories record Ezra Taft Benson's 1946 postwar relief visit.
prompts.text_original: In 1946 apostle Ezra Taft Benson presided over the European Mission and traveled widely to deliver Church relief and reorganize branches after World War II. Pin a country where Saints vol. 3 chapter 32 or the Global Histories place him that year.
prompts.citation: Saints vol. 3 ch. 32; Global Histories chronologies
prompts.note: Norway, France and Czechoslovakia got 1946 aid, but no record places Benson there, so they do not count.
prompts.summary: Ezra Taft Benson arrived in Europe early in 1946 to oversee Church relief for Saints hit by World War II. He traveled from London to Germany, Austria, the Low Countries, Scandinavia and Switzerland, and won visas to reach Saints in Poland. He also rededicated Finland for missionary work.

answers.name: Germany
answers.fact: Directed about 2,500 tons of Church aid; visited the Berlin mission home.

answers.name: Austria
answers.fact: Reorganized the Austrian District in March 1946; saw Vienna.

answers.name: Switzerland
answers.fact: Oversaw food and clothing distribution, spring 1946.

answers.name: United Kingdom
answers.fact: Saw the ruins of war from London, mission headquarters (saints-v3:32).

answers.name: Netherlands
answers.fact: Organized relief distribution in Rotterdam, May 1946.

answers.name: Belgium
answers.fact: Visited Antwerp and Liege, April 1946.

answers.name: Denmark
answers.fact: Visited Copenhagen branches, February 1946.

answers.name: Poland
answers.fact: Reached Zelwagi in August 1946 after a long struggle for visas.

answers.name: Sweden
answers.fact: Saints vol. 3 says he saw Stockholm on his travels.

answers.name: Finland
answers.fact: Rededicated Finland for preaching at Larsmo, July 16, 1946.

prompts.display_text: Pin an Asian or Pacific country where a current General Authority Seventy once led a mission (October 2026).
prompts.text_original: As of October 2026, several General Authority Seventies had led missions in Asia or the Pacific. Pin a country there where one of those missions was headquartered, as named in the Church's official biographies.
prompts.summary: As of October 2026, General Authority Seventies had led missions in Japan, the Philippines, New Zealand, Taiwan and Thailand. Elder Michael John U. Teh, born in the Philippines, presided over the Taiwan Taichung Mission.

answers.name: Japan
answers.fact: Japan Tokyo North and South missions (Elder Esplin) and Japan Tokyo South (Elder Wada).

answers.name: Philippines
answers.fact: Philippines Quezon City Mission, 2013 to 2016 (Elder Revillo).

answers.name: New Zealand
answers.fact: New Zealand Auckland Mission (Elder Carl B. Cook).

answers.name: Taiwan
answers.fact: Taiwan Taipei (Elder Perkins) and Taiwan Taichung (Elder Teh) missions.

answers.name: South Korea
answers.fact: Elder Michael T. Ringwood was called in 2004 to lead the Korea Seoul West Mission.

answers.name: Thailand
answers.fact: Elder Kelly R. Johnson returned to the Thailand Bangkok Mission as a leader, 2015 to 2018.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country that was home to a foreign god named in the Old Testament, from Chemosh to Dagon
prompts.text_original: A present-day country holding the home city or land of a foreign god named in the Old Testament: Chemosh of Moab, Milcom of Ammon, Ashtoreth of the Zidonians, Dagon of Ashdod and Gaza, Baal-zebub of Ekron, Rimmon of Damascus, Ashima of Hamath, Nisroch of Nineveh, Nergal of Cuth, Bel and Nebo of Babylon, and the gods of Egypt
prompts.citation: 1 Samuel 5; 1 Kings 11; 2 Kings 1, 5, 17, 19; Judges 16; Isaiah 46; Exodus 12
prompts.note: Gaza is in Palestine; Ashdod and Ekron are in Israel.
prompts.summary: The Old Testament names many gods of Israel's neighbours: Chemosh of Moab, Milcom of Ammon, Ashtoreth of Zidon, Dagon of the Philistines, Rimmon of Damascus and Nisroch of Nineveh. The ark toppled Dagon's image at Ashdod, Samson pulled down Dagon's house at Gaza, and Isaiah mocked Bel and Nebo of Babylon (1 Sam 5; Judg 16; Isa 46).

answers.name: Egypt
answers.fact: The Lord said he would execute judgment against all the gods of Egypt (Ex 12:12).

answers.name: Jordan
answers.fact: Chemosh was the abomination of Moab and Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites (1 Kgs 11:5, 7).

answers.name: Lebanon
answers.fact: Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians (1 Kgs 11:5).

answers.name: Iraq
answers.fact: Sennacherib was slain worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god at Nineveh; Bel and Nebo were gods of Babylon (2 Kgs 19:36-37; Isa 46:1).

answers.name: Israel
answers.fact: The Philistines set the ark in the house of Dagon at Ashdod, and Baal-zebub was the god of Ekron (1 Sam 5:2; 2 Kgs 1:2).

answers.name: Syria
answers.fact: Naaman's master worshipped in the house of Rimmon at Damascus, and the men of Hamath made Ashima (2 Kgs 5:18; 17:30).

answers.name: Palestine
answers.fact: The lords of the Philistines gathered at Gaza to sacrifice to Dagon when Samson was captured (Judg 16:21-23).
